acceptanceCriteria: The dogfood loop links OCM obligations so a sealed change reports requirement coverage other than unassessed, or the spec records why it cannot.
body: Filed on 2026-09-23 from the independent reviews of the V1 wave-1/wave-2 pull requests (#74-#82). PR #82 (V1-0025): every sealed wave-1 change reports 0 of N obligations linked; the console chain therefore renders every requirement edge as a gap on real history.
title: dogfood: the loop never runs `ocm link`, so requirement coverage stays unassessed
